北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有阵雨，出门记得带伞，湿度 76%，感觉会有点闷哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has showers. Don't forget your umbrella, it feels a bit muggy with 76% humidity.

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波体感 33℃ 炎热，湿度 71%。多云天气，也要注意防晒防暑。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo feels 33℃ hot with 71% humidity. Even with clouds, remember sun and heat protection.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 32℃ 闷热，湿度 79%，穿轻薄衣物，注意防暑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels 32℃ muggy under cloudy skies, with 79% humidity. Wear light clothes and stay cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 34℃ 闷热，湿度 76%。阴天也要记得防暑，多喝水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 34℃ muggy with 76% humidity. Even on a cloudy day, prevent heatstroke and drink water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳湿度 92% 很高哦，体感 31℃ 潮湿。保持室内通风，注意防潮。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has very high 92% humidity, feeling 31℃ humid. Keep rooms ventilated and mind the dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天湿度 80%，体感 30℃ 潮湿闷热。出门注意防暑，多补水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with 80% humidity, feeling 30℃ humid and muggy. Stay cool and hydrated if you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京湿度高达 94%，风力 5 级。出门注意防风防湿，多添件衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has very high 94% humidity and a level 5 wind. Be mindful of wind and dampness, bring a light jacket.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴热，体感 38℃！紫外线强，请务必防晒，及时补水哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and hot, feeling 38℃! UV is strong, remember sun protection and hydrate promptly!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，湿度 82% 较高，体感 29℃ 闷热。多饮水，注意防暑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with high 82% humidity, feeling 29℃ muggy. Drink more water and prevent heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴空万里，体感 33℃ 炎热。外出注意防晒，及时补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and clear, feeling 33℃ hot. Remember sun protection and stay hydrated when outdoors.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗炎热，体感 34℃。阳光强烈，多饮水，注意防暑降温。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and hot, feeling 34℃. The sun is strong, drink plenty of water and stay cool.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 29℃。阳光正好，出门记得防晒，心情美美哒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feeling 29℃. Perfect for outdoor activities, remember sunscreen and enjoy!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 31℃ 有些闷热。注意多喝水，保持身体舒适。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feeling 31℃ a bit muggy. Drink plenty of water to stay comfortable.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 23℃ 体感 26℃ 舒适。微风拂面，享受美好时光。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, with a comfortable 23℃ and a feel of 26℃. Enjoy the breeze and a lovely time.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 34℃ 炎热，湿度 72%。多喝水，避免长时间户外活动。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels 34℃ hot with 72% humidity. Drink plenty of water and avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，湿度 82% 较高。能见度较低，出行请注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has fog and high 82% humidity. Visibility is low, please be safe when traveling!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，湿度 80% 较高，体感 28℃。外出注意增减衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with high 80% humidity, feeling 28℃. Dress appropriately when going out.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦小雨，湿度 91% 很高，风力 4 级。出门请带伞，注意路滑。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has light rain, very high 91% humidity, and a level 4 wind. Take an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 34℃ 炎热，多云天气，注意防晒补水哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels 34℃ hot! It's cloudy, remember sun protection and hydration.
